note: One core release. The daemon `axiom-graphd` and the installation CLI `axiom` are built from one Rust workspace, one version and one revision, and are published together. There is no separate `axiom-bootstrap` release component. This file declares that release and records honestly what this workstream verified and what it did not: it is a declaration, not a publication record, and it claims no artifact that was not built.
